entries.b6c1da6ccaef6c18: Its top priorities are the transition to a business structure that can be passed on to the next generation and the promotion of sustainability management, and under its Vision it is implementing the 4th Medium-Term Management Plan (fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2026), “Step2 toward Next-Generation Business Responding to Changes in Industrial Structure.” Its basic policies are continuous improvement of its business portfolio from a medium- to long-term perspective, with consideration and implementation of necessary investments; implementation of capital and financial policies that make this possible; and further promotion of sustainability management. In bulk cargo, it has started construction of a new, highly versatile bulk cargo warehouse, targeting completion within fiscal 2026, while in liquid cargo, anticipating a decline in coal demand, it is considering building new stainless steel tanks for petrochemical products on open storage yard land.
